dataset.citation: Hammarström, Harald & Forkel, Robert & Haspelmath, Martin & Bank, Sebastian. 2026. Glottolog 5.3. Leipzig: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18840967
dataset.scope: Glottolog languoid identifiers and publisher names: families, languages and dialects, including ancient/extinct entries present in this pinned release. Not every historical spelling or manuscript variety; no dictionaries, grammar models or OCR coverage.
dataset.notes: Pinned v5.3 commit README identifies release 5.3; bundled CLDF metadata still labels itself 5.2.1. Original names and level values retained; family/language/dialect have special meanings for non-genealogical trees. No script, date, nationality or recognition model inferred.
